sentences.zh: 柯林斯沃斯首先不是一个靠个性取胜的人。

sentences.zh: 他在信息提供方面尤其游刃有余。

sentences.zh: 这些都记录在他演播室身旁的一台微软Surface平板电脑上。

sentences.en: I always start with the backup quarterback, he says.
sentences.zh: 他说，我总是从替补四分卫开始。

sentences.zh: 一旦替补四分卫上场，你就能看出一个人对转播是否做了准备。

sentences.zh: 蒂里科说，这座体育场迎来了它的第52个赛季，它与堪萨斯城皇家队的主场考夫曼体育场共用停车场。

sentences.zh: 然后他抛出了最后一个事实。

sentences.zh: 与马霍姆斯一样，贝尔也在2010年被底特律老虎队选中。

sentences.en: This was classic Tirico, a stream of improvised narration decorated with details from his boards that unfurled like a scripted riff.
sentences.zh: 这是典型的蒂里科风格：一段即兴的解说流，点缀着来自他资料板的细节，如同一段精心编写的即兴重复段落般展开。

sentences.en: A touchdown drive with a baseball leitmotif.
sentences.zh: 一次带有棒球主旋律的达阵进攻。

sentences.en: This suavity is a solvent.
sentences.zh: 这种温文尔雅的魅力有一种化解尴尬的作用。

sentences.en: Highland calls Tirico the master of sanitation for his talent at cleaning up awkward on-air moments.
sentences.zh: 海兰德称蒂里科为“净化大师”，因为他擅长化解直播中的尴尬时刻。

sentences.en: He's also expert at knowing what not to say, a key skill he shares with most every NFL announcer.
sentences.zh: 他也非常擅长知道什么话不该说，这是他与几乎所有NFL解说员共同具备的一项关键技能。

sentences.en: During the run of Sunday Night Football, a period that corresponds almost exactly to the tenure of the NFL commissioner Roger Goodell,
sentences.zh: 在《周日夜赛》播出的这一时期，几乎与NFL总裁罗杰·古德尔的任期完全吻合，

sentences.en: the league has achieved unprecedented popularity while experiencing a breathtaking series of scandals.
sentences.zh: 该联盟在经历了一系列令人瞠目结舌的丑闻的同时，也达到了空前的受欢迎程度。

sentences.en: It has been accused of racism and sexism, been scrutinized over the racial disparity between its owners, executives, and head coaches, and its majority black workforce of players,
sentences.zh: 它被指控存在种族主义和性别歧视，其老板、高管、主教练与占球员多数的黑人群体之间存在的种族鸿沟受到了严格审视，

sentences.en: been assailed for inadequate handling of off-field violence, and abuse charges, and settled numerous lawsuits, including the Colin Kaepernick collusion grievance
sentences.zh: 它因对场外暴力和虐待指控处理不当而受到猛烈抨击，并平息了无数诉讼，包括科林·卡佩尼克的合谋申诉

sentences.en: and a class action stemming from the epidemic of chronic traumatic encephalopathy and other cognitive impairments among former players.
sentences.zh: 以及因前球员中慢性创伤性脑病和其他认知障碍流行而引发的一起集体诉讼。

sentences.en: These vexations hover over the weekly orgy of televised football, conspicuous in their absence.
sentences.zh: 这些烦心事萦绕在每周电视转播的橄榄球狂欢之上，却又因其缺席而格外显眼。

sentences.en: The NFL refers to TV networks as broadcast partners, a phrase that implies a certain ideological lockstep.
sentences.zh: NFL将各大电视网称为“转播伙伴”，这个词暗示了一种意识形态上的步调一致。

sentences.en: That characterization doesn't sit well at SNF.
sentences.zh: 这种定性在《周日夜赛》并不吃香。

sentences.en: We're not a mouthpiece for the NFL, Highland says.
sentences.zh: 海兰德说，我们不是NFL的喉舌。

sentences.en: Tirico views the problem as one of context.
sentences.zh: 蒂里科将这个问题视为一个语境问题。

sentences.en: In general, he says, the body of a football game is a really poor place to have an intelligent discussion of a significant issue.
sentences.zh: 他说，总的来说，一场橄榄球比赛的本体其实是一个极不适合就重大议题展开理性讨论的场所。

sentences.en: A better venue, he suggests, is a pregame or postgame show, where the careful hashing through of a domestic assault charge or a racial justice protest
sentences.zh: 他建议，更好的场地是赛前或赛后节目，在那里对家暴指控或种族正义抗议进行仔细的探讨

sentences.en: will not be interrupted by a punt return.
sentences.zh: 将不会被一次弃踢回攻所打断。

sentences.en: But a skeptic might point out that those conversations rarely do take place on such shows, and while the NFL and broadcasters often prefer to distinguish
sentences.zh: 但怀疑论者可能会指出，这类对话在这些节目中其实很少发生，而且虽然NFL和转播商经常倾向于区分

sentences.en: between on- and off-the-field matters, the reality is fuzzier.
sentences.zh: 场内和场外的事情，但现实却更加模糊不清。

sentences.en: Last season, when the Buffalo Bills safety DeMar Hamlin went into cardiac arrest after making a hard tackle, the near-death experience
sentences.zh: 上个赛季，当布法罗比尔队的防守安全卫德马尔·哈姆林在完成一次凶狠的擒抱后心脏骤停时，这次濒死经历

sentences.en: caught ESPN's Monday Night Football flat-footed.
sentences.zh: 让ESPN的《周日橄榄球之夜》措手不及。

sentences.en: The moment called for a moral vocabulary, or at least for journalism's hard questions, but the broadcast mustered mostly platitudes.
sentences.zh: 这一时刻需要道德话语，或者至少需要新闻界尖锐的提问，但转播方大多只说了一些陈词滥调。

sentences.en: For viewers, part of the shock was the jarring tonal shift as the game was postponed and then canceled, a disruption of televised football's usual brisk rhythms,
sentences.zh: 对观众来说，部分震惊来自于比赛被推迟然后取消时那令人不适的基调转变，这打乱了电视转播橄榄球惯常的快节奏，

sentences.en: where the frequent carting off of injured players is marked by perfunctory words of concern as play swiftly resumes.
sentences.zh: 在那种节奏中，受伤球员频繁被用推车抬离场只是伴随着流于形式的关切话语，比赛便迅速恢复。

sentences.en: In fact,
sentences.zh: 事实上，

sentences.en: TV football is not the politics-free zone imagined by the league and its broadcasters.
sentences.zh: 电视橄榄球并非联盟及其转播商所想象的政治真空区。

sentences.en: It is saturated by the NFL's own politics, which play down the consequences of football's gladiatorial clashes while enshrining them as civic rights.
sentences.zh: 它充斥着NFL自身的政治色彩，这种政治淡化了橄榄球角斗士般对抗的后果，同时将其奉为公民权利。

sentences.en: For decades, the league has wedded itself to patriotism that veers into jingoism, adopting as its logo the martial symbol of a flag-decorated shield and embracing military fanfare
sentences.zh: 几十年来，该联盟一直将自己与滑向沙文主义的爱国主义结合在一起，采用绘有国旗的盾牌这一尚武符号作为标志，并采用

sentences.en: that broadcasters air as a matter of course.
sentences.zh: 转播商理所当然会播出的军方声势浩大的仪式。

sentences.en: Other strange scenes turn up on TV.
sentences.zh: 电视上还会出现其他奇怪的场景。

sentences.en: Viewers who tuned into the kickoff game were shown an Arrowhead Stadium ritual, the beating of a ceremonial war drum accompanied by fans belting out the Chief's
sentences.zh: 收看揭幕战的观众看到了一项箭头体育场的仪式：敲响仪式性的战鼓，伴随着球迷们高唱酋长队的

sentences.en: pseudo-Native American war chant while performing the hand gesture known as the tomahawk chop, an inarguably racist spectacle that the SNF team chose to treat
sentences.zh: 伪美洲原住民战歌，同时做出被称为“战斧砍”的手势，这是一个无可争议的种族主义奇观，而《周日夜赛》团队却选择将其视为

sentences.en: as opening night pageantry.
sentences.zh: 开幕之夜的盛大庆典。

sentences.en: Yet, who can doubt that as Tirico and others suggest, viewers turn on the game to tune out the world?
sentences.zh: 然而，正如蒂里科和其他人所暗示的那样，谁能怀疑观众打开比赛就是为了把世界关在门外呢？

sentences.en: The pleasure we take in watching the NFL, like the multi-billion dollar revenues that support it, rests on a collective decision to not think too hard about it all.
sentences.zh: 我们从观看NFL中获得的快乐，就像支持它的数十亿美元收入一样，建立在一个集体决定之上——那就是不要对这一切进行过多的思考。

sentences.en: Football's cruelties and inequities, the toll it exacts on bodies and minds, that stuff is easy enough to ignore when a thrilling show is on the flat screen.
sentences.zh: 橄榄球的残酷与不公，它对身体和精神造成的摧残，当平板屏幕上正在上演一场惊心动魄的表演时，这些东西是很容易被忽视的。

sentences.en: What's crazy to me is how foolproof football is,
sentences.zh: 对我来说最疯狂的是橄榄球是多么经得起考验，

sentences.en: Bill Simmons says.
sentences.zh: 比尔·西蒙斯说。

sentences.en: The sport can survive any scandal and basically anything unseemly.
sentences.zh: 这项运动可以挺过任何丑闻以及基本上任何不体面的事情。

sentences.en: He added, people forgive the league for literally anything.
sentences.zh: 他补充说，人们会原谅这个联盟的字面意义上的任何事情。

sentences.en: Halftime at Arrowhead.
sentences.zh: 箭头体育场的中场休息。

sentences.en: The score was 14-7 Chiefs.
sentences.zh: 比分是酋长队 14 比 7 领先。

sentences.en: In the broadcast compound,
sentences.zh: 在转播大院里，

sentences.zh: 埃西科夫从 A 车（主转播车）里钻出来，寻找他习惯的中场休息能量补充——一份花生酱三明治。

sentences.en: Esikoff is 66, tall and imposing, with a droll manner full of wisecracks aimed at colleagues and mordant jokes at the expense of his beloved
sentences.zh: 埃西科夫现年 66 岁，身材高大且气场十足，他的幽默方式充满了针对同事的俏皮话，以及以他深爱的

sentences.en: New York Jets.
sentences.zh: 纽约喷气机队为牺牲品的黑色幽默。

sentences.en: He is also, by nearly everyone's account, the auteur behind Sunday Night Football.
sentences.zh: 几乎所有人都认为，他也是《周日夜赛》背后的真正幕后功臣。

sentences.en: Esikoff's work has won 19 Emmy Awards and he has directed seven Super Bowl broadcasts, including Super Bowl XLIX, the 2015 Patriots-Seahawks game,
sentences.zh: 埃西科夫的作品曾赢得 19 座艾美奖，他曾导演过 7 届超级碗转播，其中包括第 49 届超级碗——即 2015 年爱国者对阵海鹰的比赛，

sentences.en: that remains the most-watched program in U.S.
sentences.zh: 那场比赛至今仍是美国电视史上

sentences.en: television history.
sentences.zh: 收视率最高的节目。

sentences.en: Highland compares the experience of doing a football broadcast with Esikoff to driving a Ferrari.
sentences.zh: 海兰德将与埃西科夫一起制作橄榄球转播的体验比作驾驶法拉利。

sentences.en: Al Michaels has called him the Steven Spielberg of live television.
sentences.zh: 阿尔·迈克尔斯曾称他为“现场电视界的史蒂芬·斯皮尔伯格”。

sentences.en: All sports are telegenic, but the marriage of football and TV was a true love match.
sentences.zh: 所有的体育运动都很上镜，但橄榄球与电视的结合却是一场真正的天作之合。

sentences.en: It's a story that stretches back to television's mid-century infancy when the NFL occupied a less lofty tier of the sporting pantheon and was quicker than, for instance,
sentences.zh: 这个故事可以追溯到电视处于世纪中叶的婴儿期，当时 NFL 在体育万神殿中还处于不太崇高的地位，并且比诸如

sentences.en: Major League Baseball to embrace the new medium.
sentences.zh: 美国职业棒球大联盟更乐于拥抱新媒介。

sentences.en: The experiment was aided by unlikely visionaries.
sentences.zh: 这项实验得到了不太可能的远见卓识者的帮助。

sentences.en: In 1965, the father and son team of Ed and Steve Sable, small-time filmmakers from New Jersey, partnered with the league to found NFL Films, an in-house movie studio.
sentences.zh: 1965 年，来自新泽西州的小镇电影制作人父子兵埃德和史蒂夫·萨布尔与联盟合作成立了 NFL 电影公司，这是一个内部电影制片厂。

sentences.en: Their films' blend of orchestral swells, voice-of-god narration, and stately cinematography, slow-motion shots tracking spiraling passes, ghostly game footage
sentences.zh: 他们的电影融合了管弦乐的高潮迭起、上帝之声般的旁白和庄严的摄影技术，慢动作镜头追踪着螺旋式传球，幽灵般的比赛画面

sentences.en: from the frozen tundra of Green Bay's Lambeau Field, cast the NFL in transcendent terMs.
sentences.zh: 来自绿湾兰博球场的冰冻苔原，以超凡脱俗的术语展现了 NFL。

sentences.en: Crucially, the Sables aestheticized and ennobled football's violence with highlight montages, moment of impact, that emphasized the brutal beauty of gang tackles
sentences.zh: 至关重要的是，萨布尔父子通过精彩集锦蒙太奇将橄榄球的暴力美学化和高尚化，强调了集团擒抱和盲侧撞击的野蛮之美，

sentences.en: and blindside hits, depicting the player's ability to dispense and endure punishment as masculine virtue.
sentences.zh: 将球员施加和承受惩罚的能力描绘成一种男子气概的美德。

sentences.en: But the affinity between football and TV is not just about violence.
sentences.zh: 但橄榄球与电视之间的亲和力不仅仅关乎暴力。

sentences.en: It is rooted in the sport's geometries and rhythms, in the rectangular gridiron playing field, a clean, green backdrop for football's maze of movement, and in the stop-start tempo
sentences.zh: 它植根于这项运动的几何学和节奏中，植根于长方形的美式橄榄球场——这是橄榄球运动迷宫般动作的干净、绿色背景——以及走走停停的节奏中，

sentences.en: that makes room for the trimmings broadcasters favor.
sentences.zh: 这种节奏为转播商青睐的各种装饰留出了空间。

sentences.en: There are other pauses built into the schedule.
sentences.zh: 赛程表中还内置了其他暂停。

sentences.en: The NFL operates on a scarcity principle.
sentences.zh: NFL 遵循稀缺原则。

sentences.en: Teams play just 17 times over an 18-week period, a stakes-raising regimen that makes every game important.
sentences.zh: 各支球队在 18 周内只打 17 场比赛，这种提高利害关系的赛制让每一场比赛都至关重要。

sentences.en: The drama is heightened on Sunday nights when the field is washed in light and everything, hash marks, helmets, coaches' headsets, takes on a cinematic gleam.
sentences.zh: 当周日夜晚球场沐浴在灯光下，一切——球场标线、头盔、教练耳机——都带有一种电影般的微光时，戏剧性被推向了高潮。

sentences.en: Viewed in high definition, the game is both intimate and enormous.
sentences.zh: 在高清晰度下观看，这场比赛既亲密又宏大。

sentences.en: Cameras pick out beads of sweat and blades of grass, and they sweep up panoramic troop movements and eruptions of athleticism.
sentences.zh: 摄像机捕捉到了汗珠和草叶，它们扫过全景式的部队调动和爆发性的运动能力。

sentences.en: At SNF,
sentences.zh: 在《周日夜赛》，

sentences.zh: 埃西科夫是最能领会电视橄榄球工艺与艺术的人。

sentences.en: As the halftime break wound down, he retook his position in the control room, facing that big wall of screens.
sentences.zh: 随着中场休息接近尾声，他重新回到控制室的位置，面对着那面巨大的屏幕墙。

sentences.en: One showed a live shot of fans in Detroit watching the game on a jumbotron at Ford Field.
sentences.zh: 其中一个屏幕显示了底特律球迷在福特球场通过巨型屏幕观看比赛的直播画面。

sentences.en: Another held a shot from Stanford of Terry McCauley, a former NFL referee who serves as the SNF rules analySt.
sentences.zh: 另一个屏幕播放了来自斯坦福大学的特里·麦考利的镜头，他是前 NFL 裁判，也是《周日夜赛》的规则分析师。

sentences.en: Two monitors, nicknamed Elvis and Costello, had been used in the first half for a segment featuring the parents of the Lions defensive end
sentences.zh: 两台被称为“埃尔维斯”和“科斯特洛”的监视器在上半场被用于一个特别环节，镜头对准了狮队防守端锋

sentences.zh: 艾丹·哈钦슨的父母，他们同意在看台上佩戴麦克风，以便 NBC 能够播出他们的反应。

sentences.en: Esikoff was seated in front of the two largest screens, the program monitor, showing the picture currently on air, and the preview monitor, the image queued to go live next.
sentences.zh: 埃西科夫坐在两个最大的屏幕前面：一个是节目监视器，显示当前正在播出的画面；另一个是预监监视器，显示即将切入直播的画面。

sentences.en: He had a cup of coffee, and a flip card of team rosters was spread in front of him.
sentences.zh: 他端着一杯咖啡，面前摊开了一张球队名单的翻页卡。

sentences.en: As Esikoff explains it, directing a football game is both diabolically complex and simple in its essence.
